thread:
zoe (Partnerships): FYI HelixAI (openweights provider) asked to have their quantized forks listed on AWS EU Marketplace and bundled with Helix (SI). Main asks: allow marketplace downloads, with geo-based download controls, 30-day escrow hold until compliance attestation, and a short regional exclusivity for Helix (sales/marketing).
alan (PM): need clarity: will marketplaces host downloadable artifacts or only reference hosted endpoints? Downloadable changes routing, KV cache, and Dedicated entitlements.
frank (Legal): provider attached an addendum. Redlines: they want marketplaces to be allowed to resell downloads but demand a non-sublicense clause and proof-of-origin. We must add export control warranty and audit rights.
maria (Finance): escrow/withholding means longer cashflow delays. Marketplaces pay on their cadence; if we layer escrow we should define fee and release triggers. Also need tax withholding treatment for non-EU providers.
sky (SI - Helix): Helix requests a 45-day marketing/sales window in EU for coordinated demos and co-press. Not asking for distribution lock; just first-look for joint accounts.
announce-bot: reminder: partnership-onboard checklist required before marketplace launch.
zoe (Partnerships): Proposed path: (A) Hosted endpoints on Redwood with 72/28 rev-share; (B) Marketplace downloadable SKU allowed under marketplace addendum with 82/18 split; (C) escrow: marketplace -> Redwood escrow -> release on attestation + verification, net 30 after release; (D) limited 45-day marketing exclusivity for Helix, paid co-marketing.
frank (Legal): OK but addendum must include: (1) explicit geo-block manifest, (2) "no sublicensing of raw weights" clause, (3) manifest metadata requirement (model_hash, quant_profile, provenance_url), (4) export-control representation, (5) escrow release conditions and audit right.
maria (Finance): I'll model net vs gross settlement and withholding scenarios and share examples. Also propose a small processing fee to cover escrow admin (pass-through or deducted from provider share).
alan (PM): product changes: catalog flags needed: "downloadable_marketplace": true/false, "regional_download_block": [list], and entitlement scope to prevent Dedicated customers from selecting marketplace-only downloads. I'll open RD-OPS-9522 for implementation.
sky (SI - Helix): we'll fund part of co-marketing if provider agrees. Need joint PR draft T-10, asset delivery by T-7. Also want a single landing page and demo calendar for 45 days.
zoe (Partnerships): action items: frank to request revised addendum with geo list + escrow terms; maria to run payout scenarios; alan to file RD-OPS-9522; sky to confirm co-marketing budget. Please update by EOD Tue. :thumbsup:\"
